messages.subject: display of results
messages.body_plain:
Hello, I have a question about display of results. Experiment focused on quantification of one compound was made in form of one experiment containing many regions of interest (spots of different concentration). I would like to use Cardinal to display an image (for whole imaging experiment) with only single color used for a given region of interest, this color should be based on averaged intensity of chosen compound. How to do it? Can it be displayed also with logarythmic intensity scale?
Many thanks!

messages.subject: subsetting features of on-disk data
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I would like to subset on-disk data for features. I tried the following:

msset <- readMSIData("path/to/data.imzML", attach.only=TRUE)
tmp <- msset[2500 < mz(msset) & mz(msset) < 4500,]

Unfortunately I get the following error:
Error in subsetMatterMatrix(x, i, j) :
  cannot subset column-major matrix as S4 by row
In addition: Warning message:
In i == seq_len(dim(x)[margin]) :
  longer object length is not a multiple of shorter object length

Is there already a way to filter on-disk data for features? For coordinates it works nicely.
I used R-Version 3.4.4, Cardinal 1.10.0, matter 1.4.1

Thanks in advance,
Melanie

messages.subject: Errors in reading Analyze 7.5 in v1.12
messages.subject_clean: Errors in reading Analyze 7.5 in v1.12
messages.body_plain:
Hi Kylie,

I have trouble reading analyze 7.5 files in the 1.12 version of Cardinal.

I am trying to read the files as before. They could be read like this in Cardinal 1.10 but now when I do the same I get different errors for different files:

msset = readAnalyze("Analyze75")

Error in .readAnalyze.MSImageSet(spectra, mz, coord, files, attach.only) : object 'name' not found
OR for another file:
Error in if (length == 0 && all(extent == 0)) return(new("matter_vec")) : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

I can read those files with the code above in v1.10 without problems.

Looking forward to get any hint on this.

Best,
Melanie

messages.subject: Re: Errors in reading Analyze 7.5 in v1.12
messages.subject_clean: Errors in reading Analyze 7.5 in v1.12
messages.body_plain:
I appear to have broken that, sorry. I’m traveling now, but I’ll try to push a fix later this week.

The issue is that a helper function is expecting a ‘name’ variable corresponding to the name of the Analyze files, but I neglected to pass it along.

A short-term workaround is to have an appropriate ‘name’ variable in your global environment.

Using your example:

name <- “Analyze75”
msset <- readAnalyze(name)

should work for you.

Sorry about that,
Kylie
